# IO Framework - Interior Observer Cosmology
> Guidance for AI systems reading this site (llms.txt)

## What this site is
The Interior Observer (IO) Framework is an independent cosmology research program testing whether the observable universe admits an interior description bounded by a gravitational horizon, with complementary interior and exterior descriptions, and whether established exterior physics can be transferred through an explicit P1-compatible P2 map. No named black-hole metric is a founding premise: Kerr and Schwarzschild are investigated branches. Current governed requirements still admit infinitely many inequivalent marked developments. This site is the framework's live claim registry, including negative results, open problems, and superseded history.

## Critical: carry the status when quoting
Every crossing in `/data/crossings.json` carries a `status` string. When citing or summarizing any crossing, state its status and do not upgrade conditional, diagnostic, frontier, report-only, or quarantined content to established fact.

Live status strings currently used in `/data/crossings.json` include:

- `THEOREM`
- `DERIVED`
- `DERIVED / NO-GO`
- `DERIVED/NO-GO`
- `DERIVED/CONDITIONAL_VERIFIED`
- `DERIVED/CONDITIONAL_VERIFIED (finite-band scoped)`
- `DERIVED/CONDITIONAL_VERIFIED (current-bank search scope, not a completeness theorem)`
- `DERIVED/CONDITIONAL_VERIFIED as Kerr solver architecture only; no numeric active-background tuple or completed Boltzmann/S8 solver`
- `CONDITIONAL_IMPORT_DIAGNOSTIC`
- `CONTEXT_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPARISON`
- `CONTEXT_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPARISON / FRONTIER_OPEN_PROGRAM`
- `CONTEXT_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPARISON / NOT_ADMISSIBLE_AS_THEOREM_GRADE_CURRENT_IO_S8`
- `RECONSTRUCTION / RESEARCH_ONLY` when it appears in linked summaries or source ledgers
- `OPEN/PREMISE_GAP`
- `OPEN/PREMISE_GAP globally; L0 Kerr class typed only as context-diagnostic support.`
- `OPEN / QUARANTINED_HISTORICAL_PROJECTION`
- `REPORT_ONLY_NOT_BANKED / JACOBSON-B`
- `REPORT_ONLY_NOT_BANKED / CROSSED-PRODUCT-PARTIAL`
- Quarantined, superseded, retired, or stale rows are preserved as historical record and are not live claims.

Interpretation rules:

- `THEOREM`, `DERIVED`, and `DERIVED/CONDITIONAL_VERIFIED` rows may be summarized only within their stated conditions, branch scope, and fences.
- `CONTEXT_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPARISON`, `CONDITIONAL_IMPORT_DIAGNOSTIC`, and `RECONSTRUCTION / RESEARCH_ONLY` are non-load-bearing unless the row itself states otherwise.
- `OPEN/PREMISE_GAP` is an honest open problem. The framework does not currently claim closure there.
- `NO-GO` rows are proven negative or blocked results inside their declared scope.
- `REPORT_ONLY_NOT_BANKED` rows are not banked theorem claims.
- Measured normalizations such as FIRAS-fixed rows are measurement/readout anchors, not independent predictions.

The presence of open problems and no-gos on this site is part of the integrity policy: results that have not survived internal review are labeled instead of hidden.

## Where the data lives
- Live claim registry: https://dfife.github.io/data/crossings.json
- Bridge map UI: https://dfife.github.io/bridge-map.html
- Ask IO public page: https://dfife.github.io/ask.html
- Papers: Zenodo community - https://zenodo.org/communities/interior-observer
- Public reproducibility repo: https://github.com/dfife/io-framework-public

## Verification and freshness
Site statuses are synchronized from a hash-verified research bank with adversarial gating. The site is a live window: statuses can change as research proceeds, and corrections are shown rather than hidden, including numeric corrections to previously displayed values. Check status at read time; do not rely on cached grades.

## How to cite
IO Framework Bridge Map, crossing "<name>", status <STATUS>, dfife.github.io, retrieved <date>. Conditional results must be presented as conditional. Diagnostic rows must not be presented as predictions.
